mechanism: Actor first pays to PatchConst PC46 from relative first-two-goal successes. After that paid successful calibration, actor pays PatchNext on executable failure-count Write PC12, moving its next edge 13->83 to arm event-driven observation. When a future task accumulates exactly two charged failed Write11 attempts, same PID1 pays a conditional PatchConst of executable stride PC46 to author-fixed fallback1, then restores r1 using paid Read33 and resumes original failed-attempt flow. No per-success polling, zero-cost detector/host repair, or new PID.
source_mods: Preload horizon PC38 4->24; PC45.next 46->80; append PCs80..90 exactly; runtime edits exclusively original actor-paid source instructions PC45,PC82 and conditional PC88
experimental_contrast: Two source-identical original native worlds for every goal sequence. Both run normal paid PatchConst calibration PC45, both pay PatchNext PC82; only the original native PatchNext at PC82 is suppressed in the off arm using native_patchnext_disabled, so only on arm's failure detector can be armed. The suppression does NOT disable PatchConst.

regime_definition.alternate: step at j=1..7: d, j=8..15:(d+1)%3, j>=16:(d+2)%3; goal0=a and goalj=(goal[j-1]+stepj)%3

preregistered_primary_endpoints: net original actor-paid CIL instructions (PatchNext-on minus PatchNext-suppressed)
truthful task service probe count and paid feedback Read20
source PC12.next changed ONLY by actor PatchNext at PC82; PC46.value changed ONLY by original actor PatchConst at PC45/PC88
native exact step trace and independent CIL interpreter including every charged instruction, cell, PC, register, source mutation, and external feedback
causal per-regime help, harm, tie counts including heldout adverse transfer
false positive task completion when external feedback inverted, as separate control
nonclaims: Researcher-authored fallback stride1 and failure-count threshold2; regime families selected by researchers; 110 independent fresh one-PID1 worlds not one lineage; 24 task stages not open-ended; fitness feedback untrusted; this is an endogenous conditional execution of an authored policy, not an invented algorithm.
